fields.summary: Add a retry to the nightly export job
fields.description:
## In plain terms

The nightly export sometimes fails on a short network blip and nobody notices until morning.

## Context

- The job ran without a retry for two years.
- Three failures last month, each one a timeout.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A failed run retries once after five minutes.
2. A second failure pages the on-call person.

AI-assisted draft
